definitions.ask: Should sync merge back-to-back or overlapping past meetings into one closed MEET entry?
definitions.why: Groups as far as one truthful span allows; one entry across a gap would log the gap as meetings

choices.label: One closed entry per run of touching meetings; Stats splits a merged entry's minutes evenly
One closed entry per meeting with its exact span; more rows, and double-booked time counts twice

definitions.ask: Should a running meeting and later meetings get separate open MEET entries even if two MEETs are open?
definitions.why: Keeps the plan lint quiet; Event Task clock close already splits a shared MEET entry on x

choices.label: Never a second open MEET; later meetings ride the running MEET and carry to a placeholder on x
Running MEET plus MEET placeholder; duplicate_open_pomodoro_name lints while both are open

definitions.ask: Should a new decision record supersede in part the one-appended-MEET claim for synced meetings?
definitions.corrects: Synced calendar events live in their daily note's Events section with root attribution and one appended MEET.

strands: Calendar Events Are Daily Note Event Tasks
